data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX animation sprite sheet for a magical water cyclone attack, using the provided reference image only as the visual style inspiration: bright cyan and deep blue water, white foam strokes, sparkling droplets, translucent magical energy, hand-painted clean HD game art.

Layout requirements: exactly 8 frames arranged in a 2-row x 4-column grid. Each cell must have a solid flat #FF00FF magenta background. No transparency, no checkerboard, no borders, no grid lines, no labels, no text.

Composition requirements: each cell contains one centered vertical water cyclone with the same scale and same bounding box. Leave safe magenta padding on all sides of every cell. The cyclone should be compact enough for a card-battle attack effect. The core and spiral arms must visibly rotate clockwise from frame to frame, with the tail stream curling and twisting with the core so it feels like a spinning water vortex, not a static image sliding across the screen.

Animation direction: frame 1 starts with the spiral opening at upper-left. Each next frame advances the spiral phase clockwise by about 45 degrees. Frame 1 and frame 8 should nearly loop.

Style: vivid cyan, electric blue, deep blue shadows, white foam highlights, translucent water ribbons, sparkling droplets, magical energy glints, crisp hand-painted game VFX, high detail, consistent framing across all frames.

Important: keep every frame isolated on magenta, with no overlap between cells, and ensure the cyclone silhouette stays centered and compact in each cell.
